description: Bi-axial cross-context/within-volume attention (dual_axis=True) vs early img-mask feature fusion (dual_axis=False, PixelShuffle fuse_conv pre-transformer, no column-axis attention) vs the released Medverse architecture (152) — thesis Methodology feature-fusion + architecture ablation. 150/151 compute-matched: 151's arch.l=9 gives gflops_transformer within 3% of 150's arch.l=4,dual_axis=True baseline (params are NOT matched: 151 is +52% over 150, since row-axis-only layers can't buy back column-axis compute per-param — see 151's own config header). 150/151 both warm-start ONLY encoder+decoder from a stripped 108 checkpoint (scripts/strip_checkpoint_encoder_decoder.py); the entire in-context reasoning core (transformer, img/mask embed, ctx/qry id, thinking rows, cascade_proj, pool_proj) is randomly initialized for both arms, removing the asymmetric-warm-start confound the earlier 110-vs-120 pair had. 152 (medverse) instead starts from the released Medverse.ckpt (checkpoint=orig_weights) — the fairest available starting point for that architecture, not a matched cold-init (see 152's own config header for why). data.p_synth=0 (real anatomy only), CT-only (data.source_mix.regime_p=[1,0,0]) for all three. train.epochs=400 for 150/151/152, but all three are extracted at epoch 250 here for a fair matched-budget comparison — 152 was manually stopped at epoch 250 (2026-09-26); 150/151 were still running past 250 at extraction time and are cut to match. NOTE: 152 has one deliberate recipe deviation from 150/151 — data.query_prior is disabled (modes=[none]) after a reproduced torch.compile/AOTAutograd backward crash specific to Medverse's image_context NA-ICL channel under medverse.compile=true on this node; 150/151 keep their p=0.3 GT query-prior injection. See 152's config header for the full repro.

runs.name: 150_cascade_coldtransformer_dualaxis
runs.description: dual_axis=True (default), l=4 — full bi-axial (row cross-context + column img<->mask) attention, cold transformer

runs.name: 151_cascade_coldtransformer_singleaxis_l9
runs.description: dual_axis=False, l=9 — early img-mask fusion via PixelShuffle (axis_fuse_r=4) before a row-axis-only (cross-context) transformer, cold transformer, l=9 compute-matched vs 150

runs.name: 152_cascade_medverse_baseline
runs.description: model=medverse (released architecture) — released Medverse.ckpt start (checkpoint=orig_weights), medverse_bounded_head=true (sigmoid-appended head -> real logit -> shared bce_dice-with-logits recipe, matching 150/151's adamw/1e-4/bce_dice exactly), eval_autocast=true, medverse.compile=true. Same data/augmentation/schedule as 150/151 except data.query_prior disabled (see runs.json description).
